runways.geometryNote: Endpoint coordinates below are the first/last nodes of OpenStreetMap way 28113198 (aeroway=runway, ref=09/27), retrieved via the Overpass API on 2026-10-13 -- a real digitized runway outline, not computed from the reference point. core.mjs's approximateRunwayEnds()/resolveRunwayEnds() still exist as a fallback for an airport that has no such OSM way. Discrepancy, flagged not resolved: the OSM-derived length is ~3103 m, about 4% shorter than the 3230 m published length above -- the community-mapped way may not trace the full paved length exactly.

sources: OpenStreetMap, way/28113198 (runway endpoints), via the Overpass API

circuitAltitude.note: Pilots commonly round the published elevation (~1745 ft, see elevation field) up to 1800 ft for quick mental math. Circuit altitude is flown on the day's QNH, not a fixed pressure setting -- see the live METAR (Phase 3) for current QNH.

liveWeather.note: Fetched live in Phase 3 -- not bundled here since it changes constantly.

airport.limitations: Reference data for ground-based familiarization only. Not for flight planning or navigation. See README for the full disclaimer.

fleet.callSignRule: Pilots refer to an aircraft by the NATO phonetic name of its registration's last letter (see core.mjs lastLetterCallSign).

landmarks.source: OpenStreetMap, individually looked up via the Nominatim search API during development (2026-10-13)
landmarks.note: A broader automated sweep (every named lake/peak within the radius via the Overpass API) was attempted first but the public Overpass instance was rate-limiting during development, so this list is a curated set of specific named landmarks individually confirmed to exist in OSM and fall within radiusNm -- not an exhaustive spatial query. Extend it the same way (search, cite the OSM reference, record confidence) rather than guessing coordinates for a name that doesn't turn up a match.

landmarks.name: Moula Ali hill
landmarks.note: Originally pinned via OpenStreetMap's Moula Ali Dargah (place_of_worship) node, the best available proxy since OSM has no separate natural=peak/hill node for Moula Ali. The user independently supplied a Google Maps pin for the hill that landed 66 m from that OSM point -- close enough to treat as the same location and upgrade confidence from medium to high. Coordinates above are the user-provided pin.

circuits.note: Relayed from a trainee pilot's description of flying the circuit, not an official chart. Checkpoint coordinates were located individually (see each checkpoint's source/confidence) -- several checkpoints were first located via OpenStreetMap search (confidence: medium), several more via Google Maps links the user supplied directly (confidence: high, source field cites the link), and a handful remain null with a TODO where neither turned up a confident match. The GPX track from an actual flight (arriving separately) will be used to check this geometry; conflicts will be flagged, not silently edited into this file.
circuits.distanceFieldNote: On upwind/crosswind/base/final, distanceNm is measured along that leg from its start. On downwind, the pilot's distances are ambiguous between 'along the leg' and 'straight-line distance from the airport' -- the described pattern (5, 4, ..., 1, abeam, 2, 3, 4, 5) only makes sense as airport-relative radial distance (closing in toward the abeam point, then opening back out), so downwind checkpoints use distanceFromAirportNm instead. This is an interpretation of the pilot's wording, not a literal field they specified -- flagged here rather than presented as fact.
